lockpick.name: lockpick
lockpick.lore: Whoever tapered this length of hardened wire and bent it at such precise angles understood locks as other folk understand a language. The guilds of thieves throughout the world guard the secret of making such picks most jealously, for a good one is worth more than the gold that it might set free.

master_lockpick.name: master lockpick
master_lockpick.lore: In forty years at his craft, or so it is reported, the master picksmith who made this tool never failed a lock. He forged it from a single strand of spell-hardened gold, and it is said to whisper the true angle to the fingertips of whoever holds it.
